Image generation request routed through the proxy

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.literllm.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() = kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper()
    val request = mapper.readValue("{\"model\":\"dall-e-3\",\"n\":1,\"prompt\":\"A sunset over the ocean\",\"size\":\"1024x1024\"}", CreateImageRequest::class.java)
    val result = LiterLlm.imageGenerate(request)
    println(result)
}
```
